subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw accept Pioneer as an official provider now, and if so may this PR add dependency graph changes plus default Gateway full-catalog warming to support first-open live discovery?
rationale: The remaining blockers combine product ownership, supply-chain approval, and Gateway startup policy; automation should not decide the permanent provider/default-startup shape.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the provider/plugin path but remove or gate broad Gateway startup warming and the 30000ms picker timeout, refresh generated docs, and merge only after dependency/security approval is visible.

options.title: Accept as-is with owner approval
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly own the official provider, dependency graph, startup API traffic, and longer picker wait as intentional behavior.

options.title: Route Pioneer externally first
options.body: Ask for a self-maintained ClawHub/npm provider package and land only any generic missing external-provider API improvements separately.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the provider/plugin path but remove or gate broad Gateway startup warming and the 30000ms picker timeout, refresh generated docs, and merge only after dependency/security approval is visible.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the top-level project decision owner and recently handled the provider-auth startup prewarm policy this PR partially reverses.
